title: 2023 AMC 10A Problem 8
statement: Barb the baker creates a new temperature system for baking bread, Breadus, which is linearly based on Fahrenheit. Bread rises at \(110\text{ F}^{\circ},\) which is \(0\) on the Breadus scale. Bread bakes at \(350\text{ F}^{\circ},\) which is \(100\) on the Breadus scale. Bread is done when its internal temperature is \(200\text{ F}^{\circ}.\) What is this temperature on the Breadus scale?

solutions.text: The Breadus reading is linear in Fahrenheit through \((110, 0)\) and \((350, 100),\) so \(B = \frac{100}{350 - 110}(F - 110)\) \(= \frac{5}{12}(F - 110).\) Plug in \(F = 200:\) \(B = \frac{5}{12} \cdot 90 = 37.5.\) Therefore, the answer is D.
hints: The Breadus reading is linear in Fahrenheit through \((110, 0)\) and \((350, 100)\)
The slope is \(\frac{100}{350 - 110};\) apply it to the \(200 - 110\) degrees above the \(0\) point
